title: HDOCK-Multimer: improved structure prediction of large protein complexes by integrating docking and combinatorial assembly.
authors: Yao, Xuan; Ya, Yifan; Li, Hao; Huang, Sheng-You
one_liner_zh: 该文提出HDOCK-Multimer框架，整合分子对接与组合装配以预测大型蛋白质复合物结构，显著超越现有方法，属于蛋白质结构预测核心课题。
abstract: Accurate prediction of large protein assembly structures is crucial for understanding biological processes, yet remains a challenge for end-to-end approaches such as AlphaFold owing to their large size and intricate multi-chain interactions. Docking methods can handle large proteins, but suffer from the huge combinatorial binding space of multiple chains. Assembly methods offer an alternative way, but critically rely on the quality of predicted subcomponents. Here we present HDOCK-Multimer (HDM), a framework that integrates docking and combinatorial assembly for structure prediction of large protein complexes. HDM efficiently reduces reliance on subcomponent quality through docking, while leveraging the pairwise interactions of subcomponents through assembly. When evaluated on 3 benchmarks of 35 large heteromeric complexes, 172 large protein complexes and 7 CASP15 targets, HDM substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods including CombFold, MoLPC, AlphaFold-Multimer and AlphaFold3. In addition, HDM also demonstrates the capacity to predict the stoichiometry and model the complex without stoichiometry input.
abstract_zh: 准确预测大型蛋白质组装结构对于理解生物过程至关重要，然而，由于这些结构尺寸庞大且多链相互作用复杂，端到端方法（如AlphaFold）仍面临挑战。对接方法能够处理大型蛋白质，但受限于多链组合结合空间的巨大规模。组装方法提供了另一种途径，但关键依赖于预测亚基的质量。在此，我们提出HDOCK-Multimer (HDM)，一种整合对接与组合组装用于大型蛋白质复合物结构预测的框架。HDM通过对接有效降低了对亚基质量的依赖，同时利用组装发挥亚基间的成对相互作用。在包含35个大型异源复合物、172个大型蛋白质复合物及7个CASP15靶标的3个基准测试中，HDM显著优于包括CombFold、MoLPC、AlphaFold-Multimer和AlphaFold3在内的最先进方法。此外，HDM还展示了预测化学计量比及在无化学计量比输入情况下建模复合物的能力。
